bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 4, 5, 9. RIGA resumes after two trials and today he makes his home track debut. Unlike some, he should not be troubled by this journey first up. ALGORITHMIC was anything but disgrace at Newcastle on the Beaumont track last start after he became most unsuited in transit. He still has scope to improve when he tackles the same distance today at his second run in Winkers. SPUD GUN was attempting a significant distance rise when her Hawkesbury home based effort over 1300m was full of merit last start. She can only now present race-fitter for 1350m. CLASSIC TWO has been in work for some time but he performed above market place expectations here over this journey last start and he can maintain his form today without causing a surprise.

raceTips.comment: Riga has won two trials leading into this preparation, working strongly to/through the line in his latter heat. Home track, suitable distance, he has plenty of upside and looks hard to beat with a familiar rider aboard claiming 2kg. Algorithmic is hard-fit and sets up as the map horse of the race. Spud Gun has had no market expectation in three runs to date but put in an improved run last time out and will find this easier. Classic Two next best.

WRITTEN DOLL struck a traffic problem before he stuck to his task in the same race contested at Hawkesbury by DRAGON BLOOD and he should be treated with respect when he now makes a Wyong debut. DARN HOT wasn't disgraced on debut at Warwick Farm and stepping up from only 1100m must be regarded as a plus. TOO EXPENSIVE presents on debut. raceTips.comment: Written Doll and Dragon Blood filled the minor money behind a horse with upside last time and that looks to be the right form reference. Given time, recent trials have been solid. Darn You will have derived benefit from a sound debut run last time out.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 8, 9, 10, 13. VAIN TEMPTRESS was facing the starter for the first time when she looked the part over this distance at Hawkesbury. Taking the next step immediately is not beyond her here. PORTICO begins his second campaign today. He has trialed twice at his Randwick home base with Tim Clark aboard on both occasions and this journey should be ideal first up. COSMIC ORDER handed in an honest effort over only 900m at Newcastle when in the process, she indicated that she will now appreciate this longer journey. MISS TRUMP was resuming when she overcame problems to score at home (Port Macquarie) and she progress today when she makes her Wyong debut.

raceTips.comment: Portico has good form lines to reference relative to this race so looks deserving of favouritism. Tim Clark has been aboard in both lead up trials and I'd expect the inside barrier to prove advantageous. The debut win from Vain Temptress impressed and suggests she can measure up and win again. Epic covered ground throughout last time so there was merit in the run. Hard-fit. Cosmic Order ran an improved race to that of two runs back.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 2, 5, 6, 9. AUSBRED HED'N'TAIL stepped up into this distance range second up at Hawkesbury when he stuck to his task. He will have scope to improve when he now presents in blinkers for the first time. OAKFIELD ALASKA progressed through his three start first campaign unbeaten. He will make a Wyong debut when he resumes today after two trials and he will do so as an untapped four-year-old. CHARLEROI is based here at Wyong. He was a dual acceptor for this meeting and after his solid effort over this distance here last start, he must be treated with respect if this race is chosen as his best target. COPACABANA resumes after trialing twice in town last month. He was resuming from a much longer spell last campaign at Kembla Grange when his effort in defeat was more than solid after he struck traffic problems.

raceTips.comment: Copacabana worked very nicely to/through the line in a recent trial effort under no pressure whatsoever. His best efforts are above this grade. Ausbred Hed'N'Tail has been rock solid in both runs this prep when only finding one better on each occasion. Oakfield Alaska is impossible to knock having made it a clean sweep of wins in his initial campaign. Sharp Shock next best.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 2, 5, 6, 7. MATUSALEM has been responsible for most pleasing efforts in defeat during his three start current preparation. He is suitably placed to make a successful Wyong debut this afternoon. ELIYASS presents third up in his first campaign since a stable change and also since a long spell. He led throughout with a gear change made after a seven week break at Randwick last start and this quicker back-up (twenty-seven days) is now expected to aid his cause after a recent Hawkesbury trial. BELLA MONTAGNA resumes after trialing twice last month at Rosehill. Unlike some, she can cope over this testing journey first up. ELLIPTICAL and ANYTHINK GOES are other who are worthy of consideration.

raceTips.comment: Matusalem looks deserving of favouritism and now gets JMac in the saddle. It has been a while between wins, but this looks the perfect scenario to change that. Eliyass beat him last start over shorter, but with the weight swing slightly against him and the longer trip happy to suggest he looks second best of the two. Bella Montagna certainly has the class to win a race like this and Rachel King knows the horse well. Elliptical has intertwining form with Matusalem and looks next best.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 6, 8, 10, 13. MODELLA is resuming after trialing twice at her Rosehill home base. She finished unplaced first up last preparation within this distance range on her home track but her performance was full of merit in a race that produced strong form. She can make her presence felt first up today. MARETH refused to shirk her task in defeat after she struck traffic problems first up at her Randwick home base. She can only now present race-fitter. JUST GLAMEROUS was making her Wyong debut after a home based Warwick Farm trial and a fifty-seven day break last start. She handed in quick closing sectionals to score over 1200m and this distance now can be regarded as a plus! OH DIAMOND LIL and CIGAR FLICK can also be regarded as in the mix in an open contest.

raceTips.comment: Modella was an eye-catcher in a recent trial heat and tends to come to hand quickly. Zac Lloyd has a good record aboard here, she just might need some luck early from a tricky gate. Oh Diamond Lil always fires first up and has the gate speed to be prominent in running. Just Glamourous justified favouritism to win the lead up race to this and is hard to knock. Mareth was supported when resuming and was rock solid. Fitter/further suits.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 2, 3, 5, 7, 9, 12. RUSH ATTACK was responsible for an honest front-running effort over this distance last Friday at Gosford and a quick back-up can now aid his cause. CHARLEROI kept trying in defeat here at his home base last start. He was a dual acceptor for this meeting and the placement of his most astute stable must be treated with respect. ICEFORD did a top job to finish as close as he did to the winner when he was resuming at his Kembla Grange home base last start. He clearly has scope to improve when he now presents for the third time in Australia. INCEPTION finished unplaced at Hawkesbury but his effort was better than it appears on paper and stepping back form 1800m should not now be regarded as a minus.

raceTips.comment: Charleroi had excuses runs two and three back before dropping in distance and finding the line strongly last time. Up again to the mile suits and he has a home track advantage. Bold Design comes via the same race last time out so if that proves the right form line then he must be in the mix. Iceford was rock solid with excuses when resuming and appeals at the price. Rush Attack next.
